label: Synthetic onboarding demo
scope: Static email-code sign-in and household-creation proposals; no live operation or implementation
identityNote: Aliases label synthetic addresses, not real accounts or editable profiles. Verification is state-dependent.

email.nextStateRequires: A code-request response; no claim of inbox delivery

code.instruction: Check your inbox. Use the latest code.
code.inputType: One empty field; not six separate inputs
code.verifyEnabledWhen: Exactly six digits are entered and no verification request is running

create.note: This create state explicitly means household creation, after authentication and a no-membership result.

ready.note: Synthetic successful creation with the accepted sample policy; not evidence that T28 allowance enforcement is implemented.

sample.disclosure: Creation discloses limited sample access, including 10 recipes; the full limits entry needs its separate future detail view.

codeError.inputProvenance: Fictional sample entry shown only in this error alternative; never a real OTP. All main Code screens remain empty.
codeError.message: Invalid or expired code. Request a new code.

codeExpired.message: Invalid or expired code. Request a new code.
codeExpired.note: The artifact name describes the alternative; its UI uses the generic supported error.

invited.afterOtp: Check membership, preserve the private invitation context and open a separate explicit join review

requestError.failureBoundary: Transport or request outcome; not a diagnosed inbox-delivery failure

existingHousehold.stateRelationship: Independent returning-user or competing-creation alternative, not a second household created by the main sequence

otpContract.resendStrategy: Generate a new code; use the latest code

constraints: One sign-in flow serves both new and existing users without account enumeration.
Authentication and household creation are separate explicit operations.
One active household membership per user; recheck before creation or invitation acceptance.
No household data is exposed through a pre-membership invitation preview.
A payer designation is not a subscription, charge or automatic renewal consent.
No real OTP, invitation token, sender address, key or private account data appears in the artwork.
The proof allowlist and test sender are not the final product onboarding policy.
No delivery guarantee, invented resend timer, remaining-attempt counter or system-autofill success is claimed.
No feature implementation, new DESIGN.md approval, email send, account creation or purchase is performed.
T03, T09 and both readiness gates retain their existing status.
